business_meaning: Surrogate key linking the fact to the savings account dimension
inferred_rules: Must reference an existing pres.DimSavingsAccount.SavingsAccountSK; Fact grain is account-version x date

business_meaning: Natural savings account number to identify the account in queries
inferred_rules: Fact carries AccountNumber for easier querying without joining the dim; should match the AccountNumber on the referenced dim row

business_meaning: Date surrogate for the snapshot in YYYYMMDD integer form
inferred_rules: Should map to DimDate.DateSk; represents the snapshot calendar date for the balance/interest

business_meaning: Load date populated from source ValidFrom representing the snapshot date
inferred_rules: LoadDate should equal the calendar date represented by DateSK; used for ETL load tracking of the snapshot

business_meaning: Account balance (currency GBP) for the account-version/date snapshot
inferred_rules: Should be non-negative; must reconcile with transaction/activity facts and prior/next day snapshots

business_meaning: Annual interest rate applicable to the account-version/date snapshot
inferred_rules: Should be >= 0; represents the annual percentage rate applied to the account-version on the snapshot date
